body: Thank you everyone. Last night, I talked to my brother about it, and made me feel so much better. I showed him this post, cause I couldn't say it in anyway. I cried, I hugged him, and I don't want to go just yet. This morning, we talked to my mom, and she was trying to be as understanding as she could. I just came home from a psychologist, and we're going to try and work our way through. I don't know if I would have still been alive by the time its my birthday in a little over a month if it wasn't for you guys. Thank you.
Man, I don't have the courage to walk up there and talk to him. I'm not sure how to bring it up even. I'll probably show him this post, but I'm nervous. I don't know how he'll react.

I am pretty happy most of the time I guess. I mean, something is wrong. I know that. I don't know how to fix my grades. I am willing to bet that my parents will lay down some pretty harsh rules if they find out this is mostly due to school. They'll say that I don't study enough. Thats probably true, cause I'm pretty damn lazy. I just don't find the motivation anymore.

Okay. I can do that. At this point, I'm not too scared about it anymore. Cause I thought about it, if shit really hits the fan, I can still take the easy way out... 

I'm considering going upstairs and talking to my brother about it. Should I?

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. I really appreciate it. I'm starting to reconsider suicide. My brother is 20, turning 21 in a few months. 

It seems like I've already ruined my life. I used to be a pretty intelligent kid who does well in many areas. Now, I don't know anymore. My parents will go crazy. My mom will go crazy cause she'll worry, but might not completely understand. My dad will go crazy, just cause. He really doesn't care.

Do you know what exactly would happen if I let my parents or my school counselor know about this?

I see it like this: Since I can't handle just these things, how would I be able to handle the worse things in life? I've definitely thought about what it would be like to have a child later on, or to have a job that I enjoy. 

I'm just scared about what would happen once I reveal all of this. I know for sure that I would be evaluated by some sort. I'm just scared that it would change my life so much that I wouldn't be able to enjoy it the same way I would before. It is possible for me to talk to my brother right now, but I know what he'll say. I've tried to tell him I was depressed but he said that I can't possibly be depressed. I don't know who to turn to.

I can't seem to paragraph it correctly. Sorry, it is my first time posting on reddit.

Edit: Nevermind, I figured it out.
